Description: They are basically the global headquarters for this. They just finished publishing the official rules that everyone else will use to upgrade their systems.
They are all about the heavy math, working hard to prove that these new algorithms can actually survive future quantum attacks.
They look at how these new encryption rules impact national security and figure out how to get them ready for defense use.
They are finding ways to use quantum algorithms to help intelligence analysts spot threats and track online trends.
They have a great team mixing quantum cybersecurity with machine learning to see how they can work together.
Their main goal here is taking those new NIST rules and making sure they actually work on older military and aerospace systems.
Not really their thing. They build the computers and leave the algorithm writing to their cybersecurity partners.
